# GENERATED FILE - do not hand-edit (generate_combat_files.py).
######################################################
######   POD COMBAT MOVE DECISIONS
######################################################
# One hidden decision per combat move, supplying the move's
# illustration and its failure-description material: the
# is_valid_showing_failures_only block restates the unlock
# requirements (trait/faith/perk) so the loadout editor can
# render them as unmet-requirement text. It is NOT the unlock
# gate - both the editor and runtime combat ask the generated
# pod_combat_actor_unlocks_move_trigger, which evaluates the
# same lines directly on a character (a decision check would
# fail every unlanded combatant on ruler status alone). The
# decisions never appear in the player decisions panel -
# window_decisions.gui hides decision_group_type = hidden.
#
# Decisions omit explicit desc = <X>. CK3 auto-resolves
# <decision_id>_desc; the matching loc key points that at
# PODCombatMoveDesc which renders the rich inline card.

# reusable illustrations  - category fallbacks
